content.comment_body: Why do user-created web pages fail to display fully when accessed through a VPN connection using the [product_name] CMR20x0? When opening the custom page from the [product_name] Basis Module via the VPN link to the [product_name] CMR, users may notice limited viewing in the browser, which results in part of the page being inaccessible. This FAQ discusses the reasons for the issue and possible solutions. Prerequisites include: • Active VPN connection to [product_name] CMR20x0. • [product_name] Basis Module reachable through the OpenVPN tunnel of [product_name] CMR20x0. • [product_name] Basis Module web server, with a custom web page, is enabled.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that custom web pages hosted on a [product_name] Basis Module do not display fully when connected through the VPN provided by [product_name] CMR20x0. This disrupts remote user interaction due to browser display constraints encountered in these scenarios. Users are looking for explanations and solutions, but available documentation leaves many questions unanswered.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate reliable, uninterrupted access to the custom web page hosted on the [product_name] Basis Module over the VPN connection. They expect dependable functionality and a stable remote browsing experience.
